How Partnership Works

Five clear steps from first tasting to weekly supply.

We keep wholesale onboarding straightforward, transparent, and built around your menu margins and daily bar workflow.

01

Tell Us About Your Venue

Share your business type, Cape Town location, current espresso setup, and estimated weekly coffee usage.

02

Discuss the Right Fit

Our wholesale team reviews your milk-to-black coffee ratio, workflow speed, and any equipment or water needs.

03

Cupping & Calibration

Taste our signature blends at our Marine Drive showroom and dial in target dose, yield, and shot times for your bar.

04

Agree Your Supply Plan

Confirm your blend selection, weekly dispatch cadence, discounted trade or membership rates, and account terms.

05

Stay Supported

Enjoy reliable weekly replenishment, priority technical support, semi-annual machine audits, and staff refresher training.
